name: MatchExec
description: MatchExec is a Discord match and tournament management bot with a web dashboard. Supports match scheduling, single/double elimination tournament brackets, per-map scoring, voice announcements, and six games including Overwatch 2, Valorant, Marvel Rivals, League of Legends, R6 Siege, and Counter-Strike 2. All configuration is handled through the web UI.

notes.text: All configuration including Discord bot settings is done through the web UI after installation.
